# Fabric.js

This product uses Fabric.js 7.4.0, licensed under the MIT License.

Selected because 7.4.0 includes the SVG-export escaping fixes for
GHSA-hfvx-25r5-qc3w (CVE-2026-27013, patched in 7.2.0) and GHSA-w22m-hvvm-xmwx
(CVE-2026-44311, patched in 7.4.0).
